body.name: Letter of offer
body.description: Conditional or full offer for a course and intake, signed by the student in the portal.
body.body:
Letter of offer

{{today}}

Dear {{contact.firstName}},

We are pleased to offer you a place in the following enrolment: {{deal.title}}.

To accept this offer, sign below and pay the enrolment deposit shown on your fee invoice within 14 days. Your place is held until then.

Once we receive your signed offer and deposit, we will issue your enrolment confirmation.

We look forward to welcoming you.

{{user.name}}
Admissions
{{business.name}}
